name: hmi_update_dynamization_entry
description: Update the value, alternate value, or flashing settings of one existing tag or expression dynamization mapping entry.

entry_index.description: Zero-based index in the mapping table entries.

new_value.description: Optional typed replacement for the entry's primary value.

type.description: CLR mapping value type (for example Color, String, Boolean, or Double).

value.description: Value encoded as text; colors use #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.

new_alternate_value.description: Optional typed replacement for the entry's alternate value.

type.description: CLR mapping value type (for example Color, String, Boolean, or Double).

value.description: Value encoded as text; colors use #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.

new_flashing_rate.description: Optional TIA flashing rate enum name.
